Components/Inputs

Input

A text field with label, description and error (Mantine's TextInput). Form-associated.

Source on GitHub

Code

Open the code

API

For AI agents: this API as Markdown, or every component in llms-full.txt.

<ray-input> · RayInput

Also forwards placeholder, autocomplete, inputmode, pattern, min, max, step, minlength, maxlength, spellcheck, autocapitalize, enterkeyhint and list to the inner input. Enter submits its form as a native field does: through the first submit button (ray-button type="submit" included; nothing when it is disabled), or, without one, only when the form has a single text field.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevaluestringCurrent value. The value attribute is the initial value (restored on form reset).
typetype reflectstext | email | password | search | number | url | teltextInput type.
namename reflectsstringForm field name.
labellabelstringVisible label (also the accessible name).
descriptiondescriptionstringHelp text under the label.
descriptionPositiondescription-position reflectsabove | belowaboveThe description before the control (help first) or after it, with the error (fields in a row stay aligned).
errorerrorstringError text; marks the field invalid (display only — does not block submit).
placeholderplaceholderstringPlaceholder text.
requiredrequiredbooleanRequired for form submission; shows an asterisk.
disableddisabledbooleanNot editable nor submitted.
readonlyreadonlybooleanNot editable, still submitted.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlsmHeight and font size.
radiusradiusxs | sm | md | lg | xl | fullCorner radius.
variantvariant reflectsdefault | filled | unstyleddefaultBox style.
AttributeDescription
autocompleteForwarded to the inner input.
inputmodeVirtual keyboard hint.

minMinimum (number/date types).
maxMaximum (number/date types).

maxlengthMaximum length.
autocapitalizeMobile auto-capitalization.

listId of a <datalist> with suggestions.
EventDescription
inputOn every edit (value already updated).
changeWhen an edit is committed (blur, Enter).
